title: The life-engineering convergence
statement: The corpus reads present-day humanity's acquisition of life-engineering capability — genetic engineering, synthetic biology, and synthetic genomics, with pantropy and terraforming as projected extensions — as the framework's most concrete predicted convergence: the canon describes the creation in operational engineering vocabulary and states that its creations will in time do the same work, and the arrival of design-build-test biology within one long lifetime of the canon's dictation is read as that trajectory tracking; the convergence establishes the mechanism's availability and nothing more — feasibility is never evidence of occurrence, and the scientific disciplines remain mainstream enterprises enlisted for nothing.

includes: The convergence reading: the canon's operational creation-vocabulary matched by the engineering disciplines that now exist — synthetic biology's design-build-test epistemology named as the closest match
The trajectory's registered milestones at documentary strength (the chemically synthesized bacterial genome above all), carried as what mainstream science has in fact done
The canonical prediction side, which is what makes the record derived: the created-creators cycle of woh-claim-0030 supplies the claim this convergence is read as tracking
The grade discipline: mechanism-availability as the reading's entire yield — the hypothesis gains coherence, not confirmation
excludes: Feasibility as evidence of occurrence, the record's named forbidden move; that life can now be engineered says nothing about whether it was
Enlistment of the scientists or their institutions, who hold their own views and no brief for the framework
The science entries' own content, which remains mainstream description at documentary grade
Capability extrapolation beyond the registered record: pantropy and terraforming are projections and are carried as projections

source_references.locator: The creation account's operational vocabulary and the canon's forward statement that humanity will come to perform the creators' work in turn (via woh-claim-0030's map)
The 2010 synthesized-genome bacterial cell as the trajectory's registered landmark
The minimal-genome follow-on as the design-discipline's consolidation

alternatives.statement: The canon's engineering vocabulary reflects its 1970s authorship — the decade of recombinant DNA's arrival — so the 'predicted convergence' is the era's ambient biotech ambition read back as foresight.

Mechanism availability is a weak filter: once any technology can mimic a mythic act, every such myth becomes 'feasible'; the convergence selects the framework no more than it selects any creation story.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0030 is revised or retired.
Public prose slides from mechanism-availability to evidence-of-occurrence, the forbidden move this record excludes.
The registered scientific milestones are retracted or materially reassessed.
